learning_status.message:
⚠️ This campaign is currently in the [Learning Period].
Reason: Budget was changed; readjusting
During the learning period (typically 1-2 weeks), avoid the following:
• Changing bidding strategy settings (target CPA/ROAS, etc.)
• Major budget changes (20% or more)
• Adding or removing large numbers of keywords
• Changing conversion settings
These changes may reset the learning phase and potentially cause unstable performance.
